verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS automation platform like Zapier, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents user-controllable retention periods, data deletion, or history purging. SOC 2 certification, managed auth, permissions, and workspace controls are adjacent security features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
